DescriptionContainerSocketPaths: A list of named pipes or UNIX domain sockets through which Storage Explorer will automatically connect to instances of Azurite running in local Docker or Podman containers. If no pipes or sockets are given, Storage Explorer will look for common Docker and Podman pipes or sockets by default, depending on the platform.
